chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Ayyūb, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
I heard it being mentioned in the presence of Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام; he said concerning a man who forgets the qunūt: he should perform the qunūt after he finishes and while he is sitting.

key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the supplicatory act performed in salat (prayer) at its prescribed place
key_terms.بَعْدَ مَا يَنْصَرِفُ: after he finishes and departs from the prayer
key_terms.سَهَا: forgot or erred unintentionally during the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he forgets the qunūt in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets the qunūt in salat (prayer). The ruling is that he may make it up after completing the prayer while seated, showing the continued importance of qunūt even when omitted unintentionally.
